Dear Halden Pay Data Platform Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Senior Data Engineer – Data Platform role. After 12 years in mechanical engineering, testing and validation, I am moving toward data engineering, building on practical experience turning engineering test data into reliable checks, reports and decisions.

At Corvane Automotive Components, I developed Python scripts that process around 2 GB of TDMS and CSV test-rig output each week, check channels against specifications and generate report figures. This reduced report preparation from about three days to half a day per test. I also maintain a tool scheduled nightly on a laboratory PC that writes summary results to a SQL Server staging table and is used by four other test engineers. A Power BI dashboard built on that table gives around 15 validation and design colleagues visibility into pass/fail trends and cycles to failure. These projects required me to build dependable, reusable tools, define automated checks against specifications, and respond to the needs of the engineers who rely on their outputs.

My experience so far has focused on building reusable engineering-data workflows and internal tools, including automated specification checks, SQL Server reporting workflows, and a dashboard used by validation and design teams. I am currently completing an online data engineering course, with six of nine modules completed, and am keen to continue developing in this field. Alongside my professional work, I am completing an online data engineering course and building small Python projects with Flask, SQLite, Docker Compose, and Git. Halden Pay’s focus on shared platform capabilities, collaboration across teams and taking ownership of problems particularly appeals to me. I am also happy to commute to Lisbon for a hybrid role.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my test-data automation experience could contribute to Halden Pay’s Data Platform team.

Best regards,
Tiago Ferrão-Lindqvist
